title: Worg Fang
summary: Alchemy ingredient for Elixir of Bloodlust.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Worg Fangs into Ashes of Worg Fang. Add any Salt to make Elixir of Bloodlust.
fields.Acquisition: Worgs and eligible merchants, including Derryth Bonecloak.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
